dialog.bte.druid_quest_pres.2: A Hero? I never met a hero before, but I guess you're the one I have to guide.
dialog.bte.druid_quest_pres.3: My name is Oriana, I am in charge of the balance and natural order, as well as the creatures that inhabit the universe.
dialog.bte.druid_quest_pres.4: Speak to me again, and I will reveal more about these creatures.
dialog.bte.druid_quest_task.1: Oh, I didn't see you. Need anything?
dialog.bte.explorer_quest_pres.1:
Well, well. What do we have here?
The only thing I couldn't track:
The Legendary Hero.
dialog.bte.explorer_quest_pres.2: I don't know if you've introduced yourself to the others, but... I'm Antonio, and I'm dedicated to exploration.
dialog.bte.explorer_quest_pres.3:
I've traveled through every dimension,
and I know every corner of each one.
dialog.bte.explorer_quest_pres.4: Don't hesitate to ask me if you get lost on your journey, Hero.
dialog.bte.explorer_quest_task.1: Ey... Where do we go this time?
dialog.bte.npc5_quest_pres.1: Before you go, let me explain something important...
dialog.bte.npc5_quest_pres.2:
In this hall you will find Three Portals
To The Overworld on the left which is already unlocked.
dialog.bte.npc5_quest_pres.3:
To The Nether on the right which is unlocked after collect 8 different
Ender Eyes.
dialog.bte.npc5_quest_pres.4: Finally behind me you will find The End portal, which will be unlocked after collect 16 different Ender Eyes.
dialog.bte.warlock_quest_pres.1: Huh? Who's there? Oh, it's you—finally. You'be been taking your time, haven't you?
dialog.bte.warlock_quest_pres.2: I'm Noah, sorcerer and alchemist, at your service.
dialog.bte.warlock_quest_pres.3: As you know, a new enemy threatens this reality, and you’ll need my help.
dialog.bte.warlock_quest_pres.4: Bring me tomes of enchantment and the necessary materials, and I’ll enchant your equipment and prepare concoctions.
dialog.bte.blacksmith_quest_pres.1: I cannot believe it! Y-you are here! The great Hero!
dialog.bte.blacksmith_quest_pres.2: I'm Anna! And this is my forge. Here i will craft to you the best equipment you can ever imagine.
dialog.bte.blacksmith_quest_pres.3: And if you need to repair or upgrade something just bring it to me along with the materials.
dialog.bte.blacksmith_quest_pres.4: Have a great adventure and the best of luck, Hero. See you soon!
dialog.bte.blacksmith_quest_task.1: You are back! What can I do for you this time?
rumor.bte.ancient_city.title: Ancient City
rumor.bte.ancient_city.desc:
The Ancient City is a forgotten ruin hidden deep within the Deep Dark Biome that can be found in the lower layers of the Overworld.

There lurks a creature known as The Warden.

You will need to defeat it to obtain the Sculk Eye.
rumor.bte.ancient_factory.title: Ancient Factory
rumor.bte.ancient_factory.desc:
The Ancient Factory can be found in the underground of the Overworld. Before going to this place, you should get a Nether Star, defeating The Wither.

You will reach a room with what appears to be some kind of robot, you need to insert the Nether Star to turn it on.

Finally you need to defeat it to obtain the Mech Eye.
rumor.bte.bastion_remnant.title: Bastion Remnant
rumor.bte.bastion_remnant.desc:
The Bastion Remnant can be found around the Nether.

Inside these structures you can find Treasure Chests.

You will have to search through all of them until you find the Cursed Eye.
rumor.bte.black_smith.title: Soul Blacksmith
rumor.bte.black_smith.desc:
The Soul Blacksmith is an old blacksmith that can be found around the Nether.

There is a kind of golem known as the Netherite Monstrosity.

You will need to defeat it to obtain the Monstrous Eye.
rumor.bte.burning_arena.title: Burning Arena
rumor.bte.burning_arena.desc:
The Burning Arena is an ancient coliseum that can be found over the Nether.

There are guardians known as Ignited Berserker that may drop Dying Ember on death.

Once you have four of them you will be able to create the Burning Ashes.

You must place this item on the Altar of Fire to summon The Ingis.

Finally you will need to defeat it to obtain the Flame Eye.
rumor.bte.catacomb.title: Catacomb
rumor.bte.catacomb.desc:
The Catacomb can be found around the Nether.

First of all you will need a pickaxe with a hardness of Netherite to be able to access inside.

Deep within this structure you can obtain Soul Stone, you will need at least four of these blocks to be able to summon The Wither.
rumor.bte.colliseum.title: The Colliseum
rumor.bte.colliseum.desc:
The Colliseum is a structure that you can find over the Overworld.

There you will be able to place a Fossil Bait, Haunted Bell, Devil's Ante or Dusk Key to summon ancient creatures who will not hesitate to fight you.
rumor.bte.compass.title: Find Structures
rumor.bte.compass.desc:
In this adventure you will have to travel to specific structures to get the Ender Eyes.

To do this, I can craft you different Compasses that will guide you on your adventure, just bring me the necessary materials.
rumor.bte.cursed_pyramid.title: Cursed Pyramid
rumor.bte.cursed_pyramid.desc:
The Cursed Pyramid can be found in the Desert biome around the Overworld.

There you will need to use a Brush in the Suspicious Sand until you obtain a Necklace of the Desert.

Finally equip this necklace to a dinosaur skeleton to awaken it.

You will need to defeat this creature to obtain the Desert Eye.
rumor.bte.frosted_prison.title: Frosted Prison
rumor.bte.frosted_prison.desc:
The Frosted Prison can be found in the Snowy Biomes around the Overworld.

In the deeps of this structure you will see a sealed room with a Cursed Tombstone inside that will summon The Maledictus.

You will need to defeat this creature to obtain the Frost Eye.
rumor.bte.mutant_mobs.title: Mutate Mobs
rumor.bte.mutant_mobs.desc:
Some mobs can be mutated into powerful creatures.

First Oriana will have to create a Formula Y or Compound Z to you.

After that you will have to throw this potion towards a mutable mob.

The Wither Skeleton, Blaze, Shulker, Husk, Hoglin and Zombie can be mutated with this method.
rumor.bte.natures_compass.title: Natures Compass
rumor.bte.natures_compass.desc:
The Natures Compass will allow you to find Biomes more easily throughout your adventure.

Just right click while holding it and select the Biome you want to find.
rumor.bte.ocean_monument.title: Ocean Monument
rumor.bte.ocean_monument.desc:
The Ocean Monument can be found in the Oceans around the Overworld.

Inside of this structure you will find the Elder Guardian.

You will need to defeat this creature to obtain the Guardian Eye.
rumor.bte.paraglider.title: Paraglider
rumor.bte.paraglider.desc:
The Paraglider is a powerful tool that will allow you to move faster while gliding over long distances.

Additionally, if you jump on top of a lit Fire or Campfire while using the Paraglider, you'll ascend several blocks.
rumor.bte.ruined_citadel.title: Ruined Citadel
rumor.bte.ruined_citadel.desc:
The Ruined Citadel can be found in the End Islands.

There can be found multiple Ender Golems guarding this place.

Deep within it the Ender Guardian will be waiting for you.

You will need to defeat it to obtain the Void Eye.
rumor.bte.sunken_city.title: Sunken City
rumor.bte.sunken_city.desc:
The Sunken City can be found in the Oceans over the Overworld.

There you will find creatures that may drop important ingredients.

These are used to create the Abyssal Sacrifice.

You must defeat the Leviathan to obtain the Abyss Eye.
rumor.bte.the_wither.title: The Wither
rumor.bte.the_wither.desc:
The Wither is a boss that must be summoned using Soul Stone blocks and Wither Skeleton Skulls.

You will need to defeat it to obtain the Nether Star.
rumor.bte.twilight_forest.title: Twilight Forest
rumor.bte.twilight_forest.desc:
Twilight Forest is a new dimension composed of a dense forest and perpetual twilight.

To activate the portal you must throw a Diamond into the lake near Oriana.
page.bte.crimson_mosquito.title: Crimson Mosquito
page.bte.crimson_mosquito.desc:
Crimson Mosquito can be found in the Crimson Forest biome.

They may drop Crimson Mosquito Proboscis on death.

If they have absorbed the player's
blood, they may drop Blood Sac on death.
page.bte.crimson_mosquito_larva.title: Crimson M. Larva
page.bte.crimson_mosquito_larva.desc:
Crimson Mosquito Larva may be 
dropped by a Crimson Mosquito on
death.

They can be used to tamed Warped Toads or transform Stradpoles to Straddlers.
page.bte.enderiophage.title: Enderiophage
page.bte.enderiophage.desc:
The Enderiophage is a virus-like creature that can be found around the End dimension.

if you are not careful enough they will infect you with Ender Flu, a lethal issue that can only be cured eating a Chorus Fruit.

An Enderiophage may drop a Capsip on death.
page.bte.fly.title: Fly
page.bte.fly.desc:
Flies can be found over the Overworld.

They are able to damage Undead Creatures like Skeleton or Zombies.

Flies may drop a Maggot on death.

A Fly will be transform into a Crimson Mosquito if stay enough time in the 
Nether.
page.bte.horse.title: Horse
page.bte.horse.desc:
A tamed Horse can be set as a Personal Horse pressing the P key while you are riding it.

Then while you are in the Overworld you can call it pressing the º key.
page.bte.mauler.title: Mauler
page.bte.mauler.desc:
The Mauler can be found in a Raid.

They can be tamed by feeding them enough rotten flesh.

Once tamed they are allowed to being equipped with Mauler Armor of different tiers: Iron, Gold, Diamond, Illagium and Netherite.
page.bte.mungus.title: Mungus
page.bte.mungus.desc:
The Mungus can be found in the 
Mushroom Fields biome.

They will randomly shed Mungal Spores.

Mungus with Mushrooms on their head will fire beams at Mushrooms. If the Mushrooms are placed on Mycelium or Podzol, the beam turns them into large Mushrooms. Otherwise, the Mushrooms spread to adjacent blocks.
page.bte.mysterious_worm.title: Mysterious Worm
page.bte.mysterious_worm.desc:
The Mysterious Worm is a needed item to summon a powerful entity known as the Void Worm.

To create it you need to place a Capsip and then right click it while you are holding a Crimson Mosquito Larva on your hand.
page.bte.raker.title: Raker
page.bte.raker.desc:
The Raker can be found in a Raid.

They can be tamed by feeding them a pufferfish if their health is low enough.

Once tamed they are allowed to being equipped with Raker Armor and Raker Claws of different tiers: Iron, Gold, Diamond, Illagium and Netherite.
page.bte.scrounger.title: Scrounger
page.bte.scrounger.desc:
The Scrounger can be found in a Raid.

They can be tamed by feeding them enough spider eyes if no Beast Tamers are around.

Once tamed they are allowed to being equipped with a Scrounger Pouch to carry potions.
page.bte.straddler.title: Straddler
page.bte.straddler.desc:
Straddlers can be found in the Basalt Delta biome.

They may drop Basalt and Straddlite on death.

The Straddlite can be combined with Netherite to make a Straddleboard.
page.bte.void_worm.title: Void Worm
page.bte.void_worm.desc:
The Void Worm is a powerful entity that must be summoned throwing a Mysterious Worm into the End void.

You must defeat this creature to obtain the Parasite Eye.
page.bte.warped_mosco.title: Warped Mosco
page.bte.warped_mosco.desc:
The Warped Mosco is a strong creature that can be summoned if the right circumstances occur.

First a Mungus infected with exactly 5 Warped Mungus must be placed on the Nether. After that a Crimson Mosquito 
must bite the Mungus.

Once defeated the Warped Mosco may drop Warped Muscle and Hemolymph Sac on death.
page.bte.wild_ravager.title: Wild Ravager
page.bte.wild_ravager.desc:
The Wild Ravager can be found in a Raid.

They can be tamed when stunned with a shield by feeding them hay bales.

Once tamed they can be ridden and are allowed to being equipped with a Ravager Armor of different tiers: Iron, Gold, Diamond, Illagium and Netherite.
page.bte.wolf.title: Wolf
page.bte.wolf.desc:
A Wolf can be tamed feeding it with
Bones.

A tamed Wolf can be equipped with armor of different levels: Leather, Gold, Iron, Diamond and Netherite.
bte_mobs.enchanted_book.unlocked: You have unlocked the recipe for %s!
bte_mobs.enchanted_book.locked: Requires %d Ender Eyes to use this book
bte_mobs.enchanted_book.locked_chat: You cannot use this book yet. You need %d Ender Eyes.
bte_mobs.enchanted_book.already_unlocked: You have already unlocked the recipe for %s!
gui.bte_mobs.blacksmith.no_animations.to: Skip the Blacksmith's hammering animation. The crafted item appears on the forge instantly.
desc.quest.anna_alpha_yeti:
If you find a big, tall, furry creature in an ice cave in the Twilight Forest, it's probably the Alpha Yeti.

Please, Hero, defeat it and bring me its fur.
desc.quest.anna_ancient_mines:
Mining? Not my thing, ask Antonio.

Although... there's one in particular in the Overworld, known as the Ancient Mines, that is very dangerous. I think it may be hiding an unknown material.

Please, Hero, explore those mines and bring me that material!
desc.quest.anna_carminite_giant_block:
No matter how many times I try! I just can't work Diamond with my Anvil!

I need a material tougher than Diamond, but there's no such thing in the Overworld.

Oriana told me about a giant block that could be used to plate my Anvil.

It appears beneath the floating islands of the Twilight Forest, but it has to be mined with a Giant Pickaxe.

Unfortunately, I can't help you with that, Hero! Ask Oriana; I'm sure she can tell you more.
desc.quest.anna_creeper_spores:
Have you ever wondered how Creepers explode? No, silly, it's not the gunpowder... well, not only that. They have spores inside them.

If you kill a Creeper with an explosion, it will drop this valuable material. Bring it to me and I'll make you something you'll love!
desc.quest.anna_hydra:
A three-headed serpent whose flames can melt obsidian itself? Yes, the Hydra lives near a Fire Swamp in the Twilight Forest.

Please, Hero, find it, defeat it and bring me some of its fiery blood.
desc.quest.anna_knight_phantom:
Life after death? Sorry, that's not my field, although I once heard Noah mumbling about some Knight Phantoms dwelling in the Twilight Forest.

Defeat them and bring me their essence so I can apply it to your armor.
desc.quest.anna_labyrinth:
The Labyrinth... You'll recognize the entrance by the two great serpent-shaped structures that guard it. Rumor has it that in its deepest part lies a treasure granted by the sun god himself.

Bring it to me and maybe I can forge you a sword blessed by that deity.
desc.quest.anna_mutant_husk:
Mutants? Yes, Oriana told me about them. Most of them don't interest me, except the Husk you can find in deserts.

Mutate it, defeat it and maybe I can make you a mighty Hammer, a Horn and even... a Cannon!
desc.quest.anna_naga:
The Twilight Forest? Yes, Oriana told me a little about that place. I've never been there, but she told me about a serpent-like creature known as the Naga.

Defeat it, bring me its scales and maybe, just maybe, I can forge you armor better than iron!
desc.quest.anna_netherite_monstrosity:
Neither Diamond nor Carminite... There's an even tougher material: Netherite!

Antonio told me about an old abandoned forge in the Nether, guarded by a terrifying golem made of that very material.

Defeat it so I can learn more about that place and make you better weapons and armor.
desc.quest.anna_wraith:
Wraiths roam the Soul Sand Valleys of the Nether, guarding lost souls.

Defeat one and, with what it leaves behind, I'll be able to forge you new weapons and artifacts.
desc.quest.anna_scorched_mines:
I'm sorry, Hero, right now I can hardly make you anything that uses Iron: there's something I still don't know.

Please, head to the Scorched Mines and find the Scorched Forge Manual somewhere in there. I think with it I'll be able to learn to forge so many more things for you!
desc.quest.anna_shears:
As you may know, Shears are useful for getting leaves from trees or shearing sheep.

But they also have another use: they let you cut Coral, which will be especially useful for crafting the Exotic Eye.
desc.quest.anna_leather_helmet:
Welcome, Hero! As you may have noticed, making armor isn't easy, so you'll need my help.

Open the crafting interface from the dialog window and I'll help you make a Leather Cap.

If you have any doubts, don't hesitate to press the Tutorial button in the dialog window.
task.quest.anna_leather_helmet.0: Craft a Leather Cap with Anna
desc.quest.anna_helmet_upgrade:
Well done! Now that you have a Leather Cap, you can upgrade it at Anna's forge.

There are many possible upgrades: for example, 2 Iron Ingots make the Archer's Hood.
task.quest.anna_helmet_upgrade.0: Upgrade the Leather Cap with Anna
task.quest.anna_turtle_ore.0: Mine a Turtle Ore [PLACEHOLDER: Item X]
desc.quest.antonio_dungeons_plus_tower:
You're not just going to walk everywhere, are you? In the different dimensions you'll find some pillars that let you travel the world freely.

Let's make a deal: activate one and, in return, I'll give you a Paraglider. Deal?
task.quest.antonio_dungeons_plus_tower.0: Activate a Waystone outside the Lobby
desc.quest.antonio_ghostly_pickaxe:
The Ancient Mines? Yes, during my travels as an explorer I found that place and marked it on a map.

I'll give it to you, but in return you'll have to bring me a Ghostly Pickaxe.

To get one, you'll need to find an Underminer deep inside the mineshafts and defeat it. It won't be easy: it's immune to physical damage.
desc.quest.antonio_guster_eye:
So you want to go to the Shiraz Palace? You're probably looking for the Lamp of Cinders to get rid of the pesky thorns surrounding the castle in the Twilight Forest.

All right: find a desert, defeat a Guster and bring me its eye. In return, I'll give you a map to that palace.
desc.quest.antonio_iceologer:
The Snowy Temple? Yes, the Cold Eye is hidden there. I suppose you want a map that leads you there.

All right, defeat an Iceologer and it's yours; I never liked those guys.
desc.quest.anna_keep_kayra:
Quite a tall tower, isn't it? Who built it? I have no idea, but among all its treasures lies Lunar Scrap. Yes, you heard right, Lunar!

I don't know why the Moon has blessed us with such a thing, but bring it to me and I'll be able to make you a very special weapon...
desc.quest.oriana_mutant_blaze:
Hmmm, you must have seen what happens when a creature as weak as a zombie mutates, Hero... Now think of a Blaze. Yes... definitely a fascinating creature.

Mutate a Blaze, defeat it and come back to me. Good luck, Hero.
desc.quest.oriana_mutant_hoglin:
That variant of the Nether pigs... Hoglins are fascinating creatures, but very dangerous.

Mutate a Hoglin, defeat it and come back to me; I think Anna might be interested in whatever you extract from that creature.
desc.quest.oriana_mutant_shulker:
Shulkers... hmmm, creatures that, for some strange reason, can only be found in those abandoned cities of the End.

Mutate one, defeat it and bring me its mutated shell; I think Anna could use it to reinforce your shield.
desc.quest.oriana_mutant_wither_skeleton:
Wither Skeletons... hmmm, yes, such deadly creatures, and even deadlier when mutated.

Mutate a Wither Skeleton, defeat it and come back to me. Don't forget to extract every part of its body; Anna will find them especially useful.
desc.quest.antonio_natures_compass:
Nature's Compass? Yes, it's a classic: it lets you find all kinds of biomes.

Besides, it's easy to make; just bring me some Oak Logs and a Stick and I'll give you one.
desc.quest.anna_pillager_fortress: Find the Jailer's Key in the prisoners' room at the top of the Pillager Fortress and bring it to Anna.
desc.quest.antonio_rattlesnake_rattle:
The Labyrinth? Yes, I know that structure. You could even say it's blessed, or cursed, depending on how you look at it, by a sun god.

I'll give you a map to that place, but for that you'll have to bring me a Rattlesnake Rattle, dropped by the Rattlesnakes in the deserts.
desc.quest.antonio_rose_bush:
The Thornborn Towers? If you're asking me that, Noah must have sent you.

Ever since I've been here I've missed the smell of flowers. Bring me a Rose Bush and I'll give you a map.
desc.quest.antonio_rotten_flesh:
The Plague Asylum? What could take you to that rotten place? Look, never mind, don't answer.

Bring me Rotten Flesh and I'll give you a map pointing to that disgusting place.
desc.quest.oriana_shiraz_palace:
Oh... so you want to clear the thorns blocking the way to the great castle in the Twilight Forest?

Yes... I'm afraid you can't use Shears for that... but... hmmm, the Lamp of Cinders, found in the Shiraz Palace, will let you get rid of those thorns.

Bring it to me, Hero.
desc.quest.antonio_soul_bead:
Looking for a Nether Fortress? If so, you should defeat the Wraiths and get Soul Beads.

Right-click with one of them in your hand and it will show you the way to a Nether Fortress.

Also, if you bring me one, I'll give you a map to the Nether Reactor. I think Noah wants something that can only be found in that radioactive place.
desc.quest.antonio_wildfire_core:
Wildfires? I don't know exactly what they are, but if I had to guess, I'd say they're relatives of the Blazes.

Bring me one of their cores and, in return, I'll give you a map pointing to a place in the Nether known as the Pipeline.

I think Noah wants to find something that can only be found deep inside that place.
desc.quest.antonio_wind_essence:
The Levitation Stone? I suppose you want to reach that floating castle to get the Celestial Eye.

There's a creature linked to that place, the Windcaller, which you'll find in high places of the Overworld. Bring me its essence and I can make you one.
desc.quest.noah_artifacts:
Artifacts will be very useful on this long journey, Hero.

They can be equipped in the Curios interface of your inventory and their effects can be used with the X, C and V keys.
desc.quest.noah_create_potion:
Brew any potion at my potion table.

I imagine you can do it on your own, but if you're unsure how, you can check the tutorial in my dialog window, Hero.
desc.quest.noah_deliver_iron_golden_appl:
As you've probably guessed, or so I hope, Iron Apples and Golden Apples give you certain benefits when you eat them: they're not just food.

To make them you can use the Summoning Altar on the first floor of this place.

Bring me an Iron Apple and a Golden Apple and I'll reward you, Hero.
desc.quest.noah_deliver_enchanted_apples:
You've seen that Iron Apples are quite common and can easily be upgraded to their golden versions.

It's time to take the next step and make their enchanted versions.

Bring me one of each and I'll reward you for it.
desc.quest.noah_enchant_object:
Enchanting tables? Do you think a mere mortal like you can use them? I'm afraid those old relics can only be used by Evokers.

But don't worry, I'll help you enchant. If you're not sure how, you can check my tutorial in the dialog window.
desc.quest.noah_enchanted_book:
Find an Enchanted Book on your adventures and show it to me.

Don't worry, I won't keep it; I just want to make sure you can tell an ordinary book from an enchanted one, so you don't waste my time, Hero.
desc.quest.noah_incendium_sanctum:
Wouldn't it be useful to raise or lower the level of your enchanted books?

I can do it, but I need a tome kept by the Evokers in a hidden structure in the Nether known as the Sanctum.

As before, Antonio can help you find it. Bring it to me and I'll help you with that, Hero.
desc.quest.noah_infested_temple:
You want to open the portal to the Twilight Forest? All right.

What's stopping me from opening it is a creature hidden in the Overworld known as the Lich. Reach the top of the Infested Temple and defeat it, Hero.

Antonio could help you with a map pointing to that lost place.
desc.quest.oriana_mutant_frosted_zombie:
Hmmm, as you know, some Zombie variants, like the Frozen Zombie, can mutate if you spray them with Compound Z.

Hero, find one, mutate it, defeat it and come back to me so I can give you your reward.

You should be able to find them in snowy biomes.
desc.quest.oriana_mutant_jungle_zombie:
Hmmm, as you know, some Zombie variants, like the Jungle Zombie, can mutate if you spray them with Compound Z.

Hero, find one, mutate it, defeat it and come back to me so I can give you your reward.

You should be able to find them in jungle biomes.
desc.quest.noah_nether_reactor:
Soul Hearts are interesting, aren't they? They keep Soul Vultures alive.

I'll be straight with you, Hero: explore the Nether Reactor and bring me the Soul Core found in that place.

With it I'll be able to teach young Anna how to upgrade your weapons and even forge new Artifacts.
desc.quest.noah_pipeline:
Wildfires, which dwell in Nether Fortresses, have a core that, in the hands of a skilled blacksmith, can be used to craft artifacts and upgrade your weapons.

Bring me the Flaming Essence and I'll teach Anna everything she needs to know to help you, Hero.
desc.quest.oriana_plague_asylum:
Hmmm... Mutations? Yes, certain creatures can be mutated. To do it, you have to hit them with Compound Z.

I can teach you how to make that compound, but first I need you to bring me the Plague Sample from the Plague Asylum.

Ask Antonio; he can help you find that place.
desc.quest.oriana_big_chungus:
Hmmm... So you want to reach the cloud island in the Twilight Forest?

For that you'll need some Magic Beans, but before I give them to you, I need you to do me a big favor.

Find a Big Chungus? No... I mean... hmmm... a Bunfungus, Hero, and feed it a Golden Carrot.
task.quest.oriana_big_chungus.0: Feed a Bunfungus a Golden Carrot
desc.quest.oriana_horse:
Planning to walk across the Overworld? A horse can be a loyal companion, even beyond death.

Tame a horse, ride it and press P to mark it as your personal horse. Then you can call it whenever you want in the Overworld by pressing L.
task.quest.oriana_horse.0: Set a horse as your Personal Horse
desc.quest.oriana_snow_queen:
Hmmm, yes... in the Twilight Forest, a remnant of a royal dynasty still lingers: the Snow Queen, who dwells in that inhospitable place.

Find her, defeat her and, with that knowledge, Anna will be able to craft new weapons and armor for you.
desc.quest.oriana_ur_ghast:
I don't know how it's possible, but there are Ghasts in the Dark Tower. Did they escape from the Nether? Or were Ghasts native to the Twilight Forest?

Hmmmm, either way, defeat the father of them all, at the top of the tower, and get its Fiery Tears. Anna will find them especially useful.
desc.quest.oriana_warped_mosco:
Hmmmm, mutating a Crimson Mosquito? Yes, of course it's possible. All that blood could build up as muscle and give it great strength.

But who knows... Mutate one, defeat it and, if you survive, come and tell me about it.
desc.quest.oriana_mimicube:
Hmmm, Mimicubes are expert mimics: they can copy whatever you're holding, so be careful what you hit them with...

Defeat one, get some of its Mimicream and Anna will be able to upgrade your Blood Sprayer.
desc.quest.oriana_crimson_mosquito:
Crimson Mosquitoes? Hmmmm, yes... annoying creatures, but they still have interesting properties.

Let one bite you and drain enough of your blood to get a Blood Sac, and also bring me one of their Proboscises, Hero. Anna and I can put them to good use.
desc.quest.oriana_mosquito_larva:
The Crimson Mosquitoes of the Nether are a plague, but even a plague can be useful.

Get a Maggot, dropped by the Flies that buzz all over the Overworld, and a Crimson Mosquito Proboscis, and create a Crimson Mosquito Larva with me.
task.quest.oriana_mosquito_larva.0: Create a Crimson Mosquito Larva with Oriana
desc.quest.oriana_capsid:
Enderiophages live in the End, creatures that cling to Endergrades and infect them with Ender Flu, a deadly disease.

Defeat one and you'll get a Capsid.

Place the Crimson Mosquito Larva inside and, after a while, it will turn into a Mysterious Worm.
gui.bte_mobs.quest.claim_missing: You don't have the items this quest asks for in your inventory
gui.bte_mobs.quest.already_claimed: Another player has already claimed this quest
gui.bte_mobs.quest.click_jei: Click to view the recipe in JEI
item.bte_mobs.quill.name: Cartographer's Quill: %s
item.bte_mobs.quill.use: Right-click to search for the structure
desc.quest.antonio_infested_temple_map:
You're after the Lich to open the portal to the Twilight Forest, right? About time, that portal has been closed for a long time!

Well, bring me some Bones and, in return, I'll give you a map to its temple. It should be a piece of cake!
desc.quest.antonio_pillager_fortress_map:
So you want to storm the pillagers' impenetrable fortress? Fine, I won't be the one to stop your suicide mission to uncover the secret of their ore, Illagium, but don't expect me to come along.

Look, bring me a Totem of Undying and, in return, I'll give you a map to that dangerous place.
task.quest.antonio_pillager_fortress_map: Give 1x Totem of Undying to Antonio
desc.quest.antonio_keep_kayra_map:
Keep Kayra? Yes, you can feel the presence of the Moon in that tower.

I can give you a map to that strange place, as long as you give me a Slimeball in return, of course.
gui.bte_mobs.quest.unlock_option.warlock: Unlocks at the Warlock: upgrade and downgrade enchanted books
gui.bte_mobs.quest.requirement.nether_po: Open the Nether portal in the Forgotten Realm
gui.bte_mobs.quest.requirement.end_porta: Open the End portal in the Forgotten Realm
gui.bte_mobs.quest.locked_option: Locked: complete the quest to unlock it
desc.quest.antonio_bulwark_compass:
You're looking for the Forbidden Eye, right? Okay, the first step is to find a Bastion Remnant in the Nether: there you'll find a map that leads to the Piglins' Forbidden Castle.

I can help you with that by giving you a compass, in exchange for some Netherrack and a Gold Ingot, of course.
desc.quest.antonio_deepness_compass:
The Ancient City? Kid, I don't know what you're up to, but you're not planning to defeat the Warden to get the Sculk Eye, are you?

It's very dangerous; many have tried and never came back. Anyway, I won't try to talk you out of it.

Bring me Cobbled Deepslate and a Soul Torch and I'll make your compass.
desc.quest.antonio_fiery_compass:
The Burning Arena, kid? Yes, I bet that crazy Anna is sending you there for her fiery material.

I can guide you there, but it won't be cheap: bring me some Ancient Debris and a Blaze Rod and I'll make your compass.
desc.quest.antonio_jungle_compass:
The Jungle Monument? Yes, the Rogue Eye is kept in that ancient place.

I'll make it easy for you: bring me some Mossy Cobblestone and, in return, I'll give you a compass that points straight to it.
desc.quest.antonio_lost_compass:
You want to reach the Catacombs? Makes sense: it's a very useful place if you're after Ancient Debris, Withered Debris or Soul Stone.

Bring me some Soul Sand and a Bone and I'll make your compass.
desc.quest.antonio_mechanical_compass:
So you've defeated the Wither? I suppose now you want to take down the automated weapon hidden inside the Ancient Factory, right?

Fine, remember to bring a Nether Star. Bring me Withered Debris and a Soul Heart and I'll make your compass.
desc.quest.antonio_molten_compass:
The Soul Blacksmith in the Nether? Let me guess: Miss Anna sent you on an errand.

There's a not-so-friendly golem guarding that place; you've been warned.

You still insist on going? All right, bring me Nether Bricks and a Blaze Rod and I'll make your compass.
desc.quest.antonio_nameless_compass:
The Ruined Citadel? Yes, I found that place on my journey to the End, but, as you can imagine, I didn't want to face all the golems there.

Bring me some End Stone and a Crying Obsidian and I'll make you a compass that points to that ancient citadel.
desc.quest.antonio_sandy_compass:
The Sandy Compass? Are you sure? The Cursed Pyramid is quite a dangerous place.

If you go there, you should take a Brush with you: you'll need it to find an important artifact inside the Suspicious Sand.

Bring me Sandstone and a Cactus and I'll make your compass.
desc.quest.antonio_submersible_compass:
The Sunken City? Have you lost your mind?! That place is crawling with Deeplings, not to mention the Leviathan...

I guess you want to defeat it to get the Abyss Eye. Good luck with that, kid.

Bring me some Nautilus Shells and a Prismarine Shard and I'll make your compass.
gui.bte_mobs.quest.unlock_twilight_porta: Opens the portal to the Twilight Forest in the Lobby fountain
message.bte_mobs.twilight_portal_opened: The portal to the Twilight Forest has opened in the Lobby fountain!
gui.bte_mobs.quest_log.title: NPC Quests
gui.bte_mobs.quest_log.hint: View only: claim them by talking to each NPC
gui.bte_mobs.tracker.title: Quests (%s/%s)
gui.bte_mobs.tracker.track_tooltip: Show this quest on screen (%s/%s tracked)
gui.bte_mobs.tracker.limit: You can track up to %s quests at once
desc.quest.noah_thornborn_towers:
On your journey you'll come across items with rather annoying curses. Me? Of course I could remove them for you, but I won't do it for nothing.

Bring me the Talisman found at the very top of the Thornborn Towers and I'll help you with that.
gui.bte_mobs.quest.unlock_option.warlock: Unlocks at the Warlock: remove curses
desc.quest.antonio_gladius_compass:
Did you know there's a Coliseum in the Overworld? Yes, and in that place there's a small cauldron.

Don't let its looks fool you: if you place certain items in it, you'll be able to summon powerful creatures.

Bring me some Diamonds and an Amethyst Shard and I'll make you a compass that points to that place.
desc.quest.anna_amethyst_crab: Defeat an Amethyst Crab in the amethyst caves.
desc.quest.anna_maledictus:
Curses? Sorry, you'd better ask Noah.

Although, now that you mention it, I once heard him say there's a Frosted Prison inhabited by cursed creatures, and that deep inside it dwells a very powerful creature.

Please, Hero, head there, defeat it, bring me its cursed material and I'll be able to upgrade your arsenal.
desc.quest.anna_spectre:
Are ghosts real? Well, at least in the End it seems they are.

They can't be hurt the conventional way; you'll need to deal magic damage.

Defeat one, bring me its Ectoplasm and I'll take care of upgrading your bows with it!
desc.quest.anna_void_worm:
Oriana told me that if you toss a Mysterious Worm into the void of the End, the Void Worm, devourer of the End, appears.

Defeat it and I'll take care of upgrading your bow with its mighty jaws.
desc.quest.anna_ignis:
In the Nether there's a coliseum known as the Burning Arena. A glorious champion awaits there.

Reach that place, get some Burning Ashes, summon him at his altar, defeat him and bring me his precious ingot so I can upgrade all your weapons and armor.
desc.quest.antonio_frosted_compass:
Nowhere else to go but a cursed Frosted Prison? Fine, I won't ask why; I imagine you're after the Maledictus and its Cursed Eye.

Bring me Packed Ice and Blue Ice and I'll make your compass.
desc.quest.antonio_scorched_mines_map:
So you want to find the Scorched Forge Manual for Anna?

All right, I can help you find the Scorched Mines, but it won't be free: bring me a Fire Charge and I'll give you a map to that place.
desc.quest.anna_rainfall_serenity:
I never thought I'd say this, but the mutants Oriana talked about are really interesting creatures.

Defeat a Mutant Shulker and bring me its shell so I can craft you the most powerful bow.
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.1.title: Ender's Journey
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.1.subtitle: Welcome to The Forgotten Realm
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.2.title: 24 Ender Eyes
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.2.subtitle: Collect them all to open the Beyond The End portal
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.3.title: You are not alone
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.3.subtitle: The 4 dwellers of The Forgotten Realm will help you. Follow the light to each of them
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.objective: First steps in The Forgotten Realm (%s/%s)
toast.bte_mobs.welcome_done.desc: Collect the 24 Ender Eyes. Good luck!
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.obelisk.title: Experience Obelisk
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.obelisk.subtitle: Store your experience here and take it out whenever you need it. Very useful on Hard and Nightmare
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_1.title: Anna Warhammer, the Blacksmith
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_1.subtitle: The Smithing Table and many tool, weapon and armor recipes are disabled. Anna crafts your gear and upgrades it while keeping its enchantments
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_2.title: Upgrade routes
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_2.subtitle: Every item can evolve. For example: craft a Spear, upgrade it to a Fortune Spear, and then to a Whispering Spear
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_3.title: Crafting an item
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_3.subtitle: Right-click Anna and choose "Craft an item!"
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_4.title: Place the ingredients
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_4.subtitle: Put the ingredients in the grid and press Craft. To upgrade, include the item you want to improve
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_5.title: Collect it from the anvil
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_5.subtitle: When the crafting animation ends, right-click the Blacksmith Anvil to take your item
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_6.title: Repairing
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_6.subtitle: The Anvil is disabled too. To repair, talk to Anna and choose "Repair an item!"
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_7.title: No XP needed
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.anna_7.subtitle: Place the tool, weapon or armor and its repair material, just like in Vanilla. Repairs no longer cost experience
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_1.title: Antonio, the Explorer
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_1.subtitle: Antonio knows the important places and challenges of the journey, and he can craft compasses and maps to find them
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_2.title: Rumors
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_2.subtitle: Talk to Antonio and choose "Guide me!" to hear his rumors about places and challenges
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_3.title: Check them often
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_3.subtitle: Some rumors stay locked until you enter The Nether and The End for the first time. You may find very useful information there
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_4.title: Compasses and maps
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_4.subtitle: Antonio crafts compasses and maps that point to important structures. Choose "Craft an item!"
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_5.title: Unlock the recipes
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_5.subtitle: Each recipe unlocks when you complete Antonio's matching quest. Then place the materials and press Craft
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_6.title: Collect it from the table
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.antonio_6.subtitle: When the crafting animation ends, right-click the item on the table to take it
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_1.title: Noah, the Warlock
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_1.subtitle: The Brewing Stand doesn't work in this modpack, and you won't need Blaze Rods or Nether Wart anymore. Noah brews your potions and enchants your gear
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_2.title: The ingredients
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_2.subtitle: A Glass Bottle and a potion ingredient, like a Ghast Tear. Optionally add Dragon's Breath, Gunpowder, Glowstone or Redstone. Example: Splash Potion of Regeneration II
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_3.title: Brewing a Potion
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_3.subtitle: Right-click Noah and choose "Brew a Potion!"
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_4.title: Brew the potion
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_4.subtitle: Place the ingredients in Noah's brewing interface to obtain the potion. Unsure about a recipe? Look it up in JEI
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_5.title: Enchanting
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_5.subtitle: The Enchanting Table doesn't work either. To enchant, talk to Noah and choose "Enchant an item!"
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_6.title: Unlock each enchantment
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_6.subtitle: Every enchantment and level must be unlocked first. You need its Enchanted Book and enough Ender Eyes
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_7.title: Right-click the book
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_7.subtitle: Hold the Enchanted Book and right-click to unlock its recipe permanently. It only works with the required Ender Eyes: Protection III needs 13
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_10.title: Enchanted items too
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_10.subtitle: Items that are already enchanted are downgraded to the highest level your Ender Eyes allow. Their tooltip shows the level in use and how many eyes you need for the full level
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_8.title: Noah's enchanting interface
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_8.subtitle: Unlocked enchantments appear in the list of Noah's enchanting interface
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_9.title: Enchant the item
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.noah_9.subtitle: Place the ingredients and the item to enchant, and have the experience shown. Unsure about a recipe or its requirements? Look it up in JEI
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_1.title: Oriana, the Druid
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_1.subtitle: Oriana crafts pet-related items like Saddles and Horse Armor, and she knows the creatures you will meet on your journey
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_2.title: Pet items
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_2.subtitle: Talk to Oriana and choose "Craft an item!"
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_3.title: Place the materials
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_3.subtitle: Pick the item from the list, put the materials in the grid and press Craft
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_4.title: Collect the floating item
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_4.subtitle: When the crafting animation ends, right-click the floating item to take it
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_5.title: Bestiary
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_5.subtitle: Choose "Teach me!" to open her Bestiary and learn about the creatures of the journey
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_6.title: Check it often
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.oriana_6.subtitle: Some entries stay locked until you enter The Nether and The End for the first time. You may find very useful tips there
toast.bte_mobs.welcome_next.obelisk: Open the Experience Obelisk by Noah
toast.bte_mobs.welcome_next.ender_eyes.d: Click the Ender Eyes Menu button
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.teleport.title: Back to The Forgotten Realm
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.teleport.subtitle: With the "Teleport to The Forgotten Realm" button in your inventory you come back here from anywhere. Stand still for 5 seconds and out of combat
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.waystone.title: Waystones
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.waystone.subtitle: Activate every Waystone you find on your travels: from any of them you can travel back to the others
toast.bte_mobs.welcome_next.waystone: Activate the Waystone ahead of you
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.home_zone.title: Your Home Zone
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.home_zone.subtitle: Use the teleporter next to the Waystone to travel to it
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.home_zone_info.subt: This zone grows with every Ender Eye you obtain. Here you can build freely
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.home_return.title: Back to The Forgotten Realm
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.home_return.subtitl: Use the Teleport button in your inventory to return
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.storage.title: Storage Room
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.storage.subtitle: The Crafting Terminal gives you access to a huge storage that will be useful throughout your whole adventure
toast.bte_mobs.welcome_next.home_return: Go back with the Teleport button
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.furnace.title: Jumbo Furnace
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.furnace.subtitle: You can put lots of items in at once, and it cooks faster than a regular furnace
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.dim_storage.title: Dimensional Storage
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.dim_storage.subtitl: A storage you can reach from any dimension. It grows as you obtain Ender Eyes
You can also open the Dimensional Storage with its button in your inventory, wherever you are
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.altar.title: Summoning Altar
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.altar.subtitle: Some items, like iron or diamond tools, can be turned back into their material here (ingots or diamonds). Doubts about Summoning Altar recipes? Press U while you are looking at the Summoning Altar
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.altar_apples.title: Better apples
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.altar_apples.subtit: You can also upgrade apples on the altar. Check Noah's quests to learn more about it
toast.bte_mobs.welcome_next.altar: Go to the Summoning Altar room
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.elevator.title: Elevator
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.elevator.subtitle: There are 2 more floors below. Stand on the elevator and press [%s] to go down or [%s] to go up
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.portal_room.title: Portal Room
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.portal_room.subtitl: Portals to other dimensions will unlock here as you complete the conditions shown in the Ender Eyes Menu
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.bte_portal.title: Beyond The End
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.bte_portal.subtitle: Down below lies the Beyond The End portal. It will activate once you have obtained the 24 Ender Eyes
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.all_set.title: All Set!
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.all_set.subtitle: Collect the 24 Ender Eyes. Good luck!
toast.bte_mobs.welcome_skipped.desc: Collect the 24 Ender Eyes. Good luck!

gui.bte_mobs.welcome.banner.ee_recipes_i: Here are the crafting recipes of Oriana, Antonio and Anna, and the potion and enchantment recipes. New ones unlock as you progress.
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.banner.ee_recipes_n: Antonio's compasses and maps and Oriana's pet items. Each recipe shows its ingredients, and compasses tell you where they point.
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.banner.ee_recipes_e: Every enchantment Noah can apply, sorted by type. Click one to see its status and what it needs.

gui.bte_mobs.welcome.banner.ee_recipes_p: Every potion Noah can brew, with the ingredients for its normal, splash and lingering versions.

gui.bte_mobs.welcome.backpack_equip.subt: Carry many more items with your backpack. Hold it in your hand and press [%s] to put it on
gui.bte_mobs.welcome.backpack_open.title: Open your Backpack

gui.bte_mobs.welcome.backpack_skins_info: New backpack models unlock by completing challenges: feeding Pandas, finding an End City... Check your progress in Customize

gui.bte_mobs.welcome.banner.backpack_men: Store anything here. The small buttons at the top let you customize your backpack and change its options.

gui.bte_mobs.tutorial.skip.title: Are you sure you want to skip %s's tutorial?

desc.quest.noah_wither_ritual:
The Wither, a creature revered by the Wither Skeletons of the Nether.

To summon it you'll need 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls, which you'll get by defeating those creatures.

You'll also need 4 Soul Stones; a good place to find them is the Catacombs.

Ask Antonio how to get there, Hero.
desc.quest.noah_wither:
Do you have all the materials, Hero? Perfect: just place the Soul Stones in a T shape and put the 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls on top.

Good luck in your fight, but please, don't summon it here; I'd like a bit of peace and quiet. Thank you.
desc.quest.anna_harbinger:
As you may know, Redstone is a stone that transmits energy by itself.

An ancient civilization took advantage of it to build a defensive machine. It's currently switched off, with a slot to insert a Nether Star.

Turn it on, defeat it and bring me its power source.
desc.quest.anna_outback_leggings:
Emus and Kangaroos... could we beat them in a war? Forget I said that, I'm rambling, haha.

Could you bring me some Kangaroo Hides and Emu Feathers? If you do, I think I can make you a fine pair of leggings that will help you dodge attacks.

You'll find them near the Badlands.
desc.quest.anna_flying_fish_boots:
Tired of sailing the seas in a boat? Me too!

Bring me Flying Fish and you'll be able to cross the seas leaping over the waves.
desc.quest.anna_roadrunner_boots:
Meep meep! Roadrunners are impossible for me to catch! But maybe not for you, Hero.

Bring me a few of their feathers and I promise you'll be as fast as them.
desc.quest.anna_turtle_armor:
Tired of placing doors underwater just to breathe? Let me make you a turtle armor and forget about that hassle!

Bring me Scutes and I'll take care of it.
desc.quest.anna_spiked_turtle_shell:
What? The Turtle Shell wasn't enough? You want it tougher? Bring me a Spiked Scute and I'll make it right here!

Defeat Alligator Snapping Turtles near swamps to get one.
desc.quest.anna_antler_headdress:
Hey, no pushing! Look, bring me a couple of Moose Antlers, dropped by Moose in snowy biomes, and I'll make you a helmet so you can push people around more easily.

While you're at it, push Antonio, I bet he falls off his chair, haha!
desc.quest.anna_cave_centipede_leggings:
Who said you need a rope to climb a mountain? Bring me some Cave Centipede Legs and I'll make you leggings that let you climb with ease.

You'll find Cave Centipedes in pitch-dark caves below Y=0.
desc.quest.anna_crocodile_chestplate: Vector? Oh... what am I saying? Forget about it! Do you think there's anything in nature tougher than iron itself? Bring me Crocodile Scutes and I'll prove it to you!
desc.quest.anna_ender_golem:
The End is a strange dimension, but strangest of all is the Ruined Citadel found there, full of golems with a core inside them.

Bring one to me, since it's an important ingredient for upgrading your armor.
desc.quest.anna_nether_warlord:
Oriana told me about an ancient knight who guards a great castle in the Twilight Forest. He wields a massive hammer etched with a rune that lets him shake the ground with great force.

Defeat him, bring me that rune and with it I'll be able to forge you a hammer just as good, or even better!
desc.quest.anna_ender_guardian:
Inside the Ruined Citadel there are many golems, but deep within lies a special one known as the Ender Guardian.

Defeat it and bring me its arm so I can upgrade your Soul Fist.
desc.quest.anna_ancient_remnant:
Want to upgrade that Gauntlet even further?

Head to the Cursed Pyramid and defeat the Ancient Remnant.

Don't forget to bring me a Sandstorm in a Bottle.
desc.quest.noah_devils_ante:
Hmmm, tell me... do you consider yourself a lucky person? Well, it's time to place a bet.

Get me some Nether Quartz and a Blood Sac and I'll give you the item for the summoning ritual of Dame Fortuna at the Coliseum.
desc.quest.noah_dusk_key:
Rosalyne? Hmmm, I never thought I'd hear that name again; it's been a long time...

All right, Hero: bring me an Allium and a Mimic Key and I'll give you the Dusk Key, which will let you summon her at the Coliseum altar.
desc.quest.noah_fossil_bait:
Hmmm, have you visited the swamps? Yes, those places full of exotic wildlife.

But not everything is what it seems... The remains of an ancient creature still linger there.

Bring me some Spider Eyes and a Tropical Fish and I'll give you the item to summon Swampjaw at the Coliseum.
desc.quest.noah_haunted_bell:
That sound? Yes, I recognize it: it's a bell, but not an ordinary one...

Hero, bring me a Bell and a Soul Bead and I'll give you the Haunted Bell, which will let you summon the Bellringer at the Coliseum altar.
desc.quest.oriana_chorus_dust:
Endergrades... Have you ever wondered how they can float around the End?

Hmmm, yes, it's thanks to the dust inside them, which they get by processing Chorus Fruit.

Bring it to me; with this ingredient, Anna will be able to upgrade your armor and craft several artifacts.
